title: iberis carnosa subsp. granatensis
intro: Iberis carnosa subsp. granatensis, commonly known as Spurred Cress, is a type of flowering plant in the mustard family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include wound healing, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic activities, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. Additionally, research has identified its potential in reducing inflammation and promoting cardiovascular health, although more studies are needed to confirm its efficacy in these areas.
